title: Synthesis, optical features, and electrical properties of a new antimony-based hybrid halide (C8H14N2)[SbCl5]
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45840-45854

A new antimony-based organic–inorganic hybrid, (C8H14N2)[SbCl5], was synthesized by slow evaporation and characterized using complementary experimental and theoretical methods.
